section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a regression analysis examining the effects of Mastery-Approach (MAP) and Performance-Approach (PAP) goals on utility value, controlling for class dummy codes. It reports that students pursuing MAP goals showed higher utility value (β=.20), suggesting utility value as a mediator for MAP goal effects on learning strategies. The two class dummy codes were also significant predictors.
